- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:1196-1273 (_needs_human_park_digest around line 1196, needs_human_prune around line 1273) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A concurrent `needs_human_prune` that updates the body between a park's read and PATCH would be silently overwritten. The park reads `body`, computes `parse_unparked(body)`, renders `new_body`, and PATCHes without re-checking the live body.
  WHY: The section can be momentarily stale until the next prune tick. The PR description acknowledges this race, and the bounded retry plus the next-tick prune make the worst case a one-tick visual lag, not data loss.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/operator_step_issue.py parse_unparked (around line 1022-1032) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: The function rebuilds the dedup set `{n for n, _ in found}` on every loop iteration (O(n^2)), at most about 10,000 int comparisons with NEEDS_HUMAN_UNPARKED_MAX=100.
  WHY: The body could be re-parsed on every park retry. Suggested fix: hoist the dedup set out of the loop (about 3 lines changed).
